summary.en: Kogoro takes Ran and Conan to an onsen in a rental car after being given a special deal. Kogoro then receives a call from Inspector Megure who reveals that a bomber called the police station to tell them a bomb was placed on Kogoro's car and will detonate when his speed goes below 20 km/h. Kogoro concludes the man who gave him the deal is the bomber. Attempted Car Bombing Victims: Kogoro Mouri, Ran Mouri, and Conan Edogawa Suspects: Unknown bomber
summary.zhHans: 围绕水无怜奈、CIA、FBI和组织行动展开的长期情报战。
